trace.question: In posts with 1 comment, how many of the comments have 0 score?
trace.evidence: in posts with 1 comment refers to CommentCount = 1;

attempts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(c.Id) AS num_zero_score_comments
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.CommentCount = 1
  AND c.Score = 0

trace.final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(c.Id) AS num_zero_score_comments
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.CommentCount = 1
  AND c.Score = 0
trace.answer: In posts with exactly one comment, 10,997 of those comments have a score of 0.
